#include <cstdio>
#include <cmath>
#include <iostream>
#include <algorithm>
#include <stack>
using namespace std;
long long num11[20];
long long pow10[20];
int ans = 0;
void pre()
{
    pow10[0] = 1;
    for (int i = 1; i <= 17; i++)
        pow10[i] = pow10[i - 1] * 10;
    for (int i = 1; i <= 17; i++)
        num11[i] = num11[i - 1] * 10 + 1;
}
int get_len(long long x)
{
    int res = 0;
    while (x) { res++; x /= 10; }
    return res;
}
void Solve()
{
    long long x; scanf("%lld", &x);
    ans = -1;
    struct State { int pos; long long val; int cnt; };
    stack<State> st;
    st.push({get_len(x), x, 0});
    while (!st.empty())
    {
        State cur = st.top(); st.pop();
        int pos = cur.pos;
        long long val = cur.val;
        int cnt = cur.cnt;
        if (ans != -1 && cnt >= ans) continue;
        if (val == 0 || pos == 0)
        {
            if (ans != -1) ans = min(ans, cnt);
            else ans = cnt;
            continue;
        }
        if (val < 0) val = -val;
        long long t_val = val;
        int t_cnt = 0;
        while (t_val >= pow10[pos - 1])
        {
            t_val -= num11[pos];
            t_cnt += pos;
        }
        st.push({pos - 1, t_val, cnt + t_cnt});
        t_val = num11[pos + 1] - val;
        t_cnt = 0;
        while (t_val >= pow10[pos - 1])
        {
            t_val -= num11[pos];
            t_cnt += pos;
        }
        st.push({pos - 1, t_val, cnt + pos + 1 + t_cnt});
    }
    cout << ans << '\n';
}
int main()
{
    pre();
    Solve();
    getchar(); getchar();
    return 0;
}
